from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper in the collection with its title and citation relationships."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The paper's title as written in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the collection that this paper cites in its bibliography")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the collection that cite this paper (to be populated by aggregating across all documents)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
